# B. Morvay Coaching & Sports Massage

> Sports massage and personal training in Edinburgh, Scotland, by Balazs Morvay, a sports massage therapist and personal trainer with an HNC in Soft Tissue Therapy (SQA), a BSc (Hons) in Physical Activity and Health (Edinburgh Napier University), a CIMSPA-recognised personal trainer qualification and 10+ years in the industry. Every first massage session comes with a movement check, two or three exercises and a written plan to take home. Sessions are paid one at a time, at the client's home in Edinburgh and nearby or at a private garage gym. Online coaching is available wherever the client trains.

Key facts:
- Massage and Plan, 75 minutes, £85 at the private garage gym or £95 at the client's home: a talk and a movement check, 45 minutes of sports massage, two or three exercises practised in the session, a written plan of those exercises sent the same day, and a message a few days later. Recommended for a first visit or a new problem.
- Sports massage, 60 minutes, £65 at the private garage gym or £75 at the client's home: a short catch-up, 45 minutes of sports massage and a review of any exercises already given, with the plan updated the same day. The usual return visit, and open to anyone who just wants a massage.
- Massage is at the client's home in Edinburgh and nearby (the therapist brings the couch) or at a private garage gym in East Calder, just west of Edinburgh. Home visits cost £10 more. Pay per session: no packages or subscription. 24 hours' notice to move or cancel.
- Scope: Balazs does not diagnose injuries and refers to a physiotherapist or GP when something needs one. The client fills in a short private health form at the start of the first visit, before the massage.
- In-person training sessions: £50 at the private garage gym, or £60 at the client's home gym. Open to anyone; monthly coaching is not required.
- Online coaching, £200 a month, paid monthly in advance, no minimum term: a personal training plan built around goals, equipment and schedule; a nutrition plan with daily calorie and protein targets (not meal plans); a check-in after the first week and then every two weeks, with a video or phone call when it helps; messages on WhatsApp or iMessage answered within two working days (Monday to Friday); feedback on videos of your lifts, up to 2 a week; a review at the end of each training block and the next block built from it; home gym planning.
- Programme Block, £100 one-off: a personal 4 to 12 week training plan with daily calorie and protein targets (not meal plans), to follow on your own, with one round of changes within 14 days. No check-ins or messaging. Food targets are not included for clients who take an appetite-lowering medicine or have a history of disordered eating; for them food targets come with coaching.
- Home gym planning: equipment and layout advice only, no building work. Included with coaching, or quoted by scope.
- Coaching sign-up order: a free call, then a written agreement and payment, then the health questions (the PAR-Q+ and the coach's own questions). A full refund if the health answers mean coaching cannot start.
- Booking requests and enquiries are answered within one working day.
- Full refund if a coaching client is not happy within their first 14 days, or if a Programme Block client is not happy within 14 days of getting their plan. Cancel coaching any time before the next payment date, with no fee.
- Services are for adults aged 18 or over. People taking GLP-1 weight-loss medicines are welcome; the prescribing clinician stays in charge of the medicine.
- Location: based in East Calder, just west of Edinburgh, Scotland; home visits in Edinburgh and nearby. Google Business Profile: https://share.google/cJ5u14vFF04bbxpgY
- Contact: morvaybalazs@gmail.com, +44 7914 390913
